Six actor callback addresses and the final task callback address are held as u32 words before their scans and written to the same existing fields. Every new read is dominated by its assignment, none escapes, and the established 32-bit GBA address representation is retained without new memory access. The default spawn branch does not read its unassigned ID local. No new incoming argument, initializer for inherited state, field width or callback interface is introduced. A 0..4 substate domain remains unproven: matched sub_08057B2C writes arbitrary indexed bytes, and matched sub_08064E14 can restore seven raw persisted bytes.

areas.evidence: A private Unicorn 2.1.4 harness compares original EU ROM, exact PR593, exact PR603 and the selected candidate: 276 cases, 1656 passing pair comparisons. Eight additional cases exercise inherited R9 extremes 0x80000000/0xFFFFFFFF; sixteen insert an actor during a failed-search yield to check that search does not retest. A negative control derived from this exact candidate changes the first bound from 14 to 13 and is detected on actor slot14. Helpers/scheduler remain stubbed and mode stays fixed per case; no real helper effects, reentrancy, timing or general equivalence are proved. Sampled invalid states do not establish an ABI/state domain, and no exact story/UI title is inferred.
